description: One monitor: settings, status and paused_reason, webhook (null without one; never the secret): url, events, consecutive_failures, and last_delivery, the newest delivery (null before the first): event, status ('pending' while it waits for its first or next attempt at next_attempt_at, with the last answer in status_code and error; 'delivered'; or 'failed' after every retry, at 1, 5, 30, 120, and 360 minutes), attempts, status_code, error, created_at, next_attempt_at, delivered_at. 5 failed deliveries in a row pause the monitor (paused_reason webhook_failing), max_run_cost_usd, next_run_at, last_run (run_id, status, item_count, cost_usd), and totals (runs, items, spent_usd). Free. Use webhook.last_delivery to tell whether deliveries reach the endpoint: a 'pending' delivery with an error is being retried.

monitor_id.description: monitor_id returned by monitor-create or monitor-list, example: '6f1d0c9e-0d55-4b8e-9a3c-3c4d9b8e2a10'.

name: monitor-get
